crossRefs.note: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before Yahweh concerning all the righteous acts of Yahweh, which…
Then Samuel said to Saul, “Stay, and I will tell you what Yahweh said to me last night.” He said to him, “Say on.”
Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. Stand still, and see the salvation of Yahweh, which he will work for you…
Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh…

translations.web: “Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which Yahweh will do before your eyes.
translations.bsb: Now, therefore, present yourselves and see this great thing that the LORD will do before your eyes.
translations.kjv: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which the LORD will do before your eyes.
translations.asv: Now therefore stand still and see this great thing, which Jehovah will do before your eyes.
